name: veiltrace
description: Offline-first browser security engine for detecting contextual social engineering and deceptive instructions.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.extract.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.extension.json && tsc --noEmit -p tests/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.verify:extension: npm run build:ext && vitest run tests/e2e/security.test.ts tests/architecture.test.ts tests/extension.test.ts
